trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops on its own the moment the last of them lands. Work through the roadmap in order and leave A Long Road (100% completion) for last, since it is the longest grind of the set. PowerPyx rates the whole platinum 4 out of 10 and roughly 200 hours: 60 to 80 hours of story, about 100 hours of checklist and about 10 hours of cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed, so this is the trophy almost every player earns first — PSNProfiles shows it as the most common trophy in the set.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story only and unmissable: just play through the opening chapter's missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only and unmissable: play through the chapter's missions to the end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only and unmissable: play through the chapter's missions to the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only and unmissable: play through the chapter's missions to the end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story (some guides word it as Chapter 5). Story only and unmissable: it is the gold every player earns by seeing the campaign through to the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (Beebom / CULTR wording)

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. Story only and unmissable: it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Both PowerPyx and GTABase rank it the hardest trophy; PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, with lenient thresholds, and the checklist has to be finished after the story. Most of the progress comes from the other trophies, so chase it last and use the in-game checklist to mop up whatever is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind. The trophy needs 250 while the 100% checklist asks for 300, so you earn it before the checklist is done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Dip into every activity the map offers — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, bowling, meditation and the rest — one try each is enough, no wins or medals needed.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through every range challenge and repeat the ones you miss until each shows gold; there is no shortcut, just steady aim and learning each challenge's par time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 spots, so learn each course and win at least once per location; the wins do not have to come in one session.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count, and the 100% checklist wants 30, so the trophy comes first. Mix road, off-road and drone races to cover the count quickly instead of grinding one series.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (100% checklist comparison)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal's fishing challenge and outscore him: keep your line tension steady, reel when the fish runs and let it tire itself out instead of forcing it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet, start a game and see it through to the end — a single finished game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's stranger mission strand; TechWiser reports that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Andy's strand as soon as it unlocks and do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand; TechWiser reports that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Kenton's strand as soon as it unlocks and do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's stranger mission strand; TechWiser reports that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Billy's strand as soon as it unlocks and do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Work every stranger strand you meet; the five stranger-final trophies are the last missions of five of these strands, so the silver comes naturally as you finish them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's stranger mission strand; TechWiser reports that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Randy's strand as soon as it unlocks and do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand; TechWiser reports that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start Tyrone's strand as soon as it unlocks and do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. GTABase counts 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia both meditating; the 100% checklist counts 15, so the two numbers disagree and this guide gives both. Possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, so do it the moment it is offered.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Which animal is still unconfirmed in the guides, so follow Bret's strand and take the hunt when it is offered; check back as players pin the animal down. Start the strand early, since stranger chains are reported to have story windows.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; the 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so three sets is the easy end of the hunt — collect as you travel and the sets will fill in.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Point the WAiNK app at anything worth photographing — landmarks, vehicles, animals — and the count climbs as you travel; it matches the 100% checklist's 100, so it is done when the checklist is.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks everywhere — stunts, kills, driving, exploration — and 50 is below the 100% checklist's 70, so it pops on the way to 100%.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (100% checklist comparison)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and get out of the red heat zone; both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia, and bank vault robberies often bring on the wanted level you need.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while you are still wanted — North Vice City's jewelry stores sit close together — and if the trophy does not pop after the third, GTABase says to rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan 100 different vehicles with WAiNK — GTABase says there is no need to drive them — and scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill Focus before you start, use an assault rifle and aim for gang members; cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. GTABase's method: steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. GTABase's method: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. It needs the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…”, after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open; expect 4 stars and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist wants 8 vaults, so five comes first.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open and get away clean before the response arrives — a fast getaway car matters more than firepower here.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Clear the fog across the whole map — PSN tracks 52 areas — and flying over the dark patches is reportedly the quickest method.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. GTABase says one operation from each of the 9 gangs; PSN tracks 0/9, so work through the gangs one at a time and the trophy pops on the ninth.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are still unconfirmed — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — so head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail; this guide will update the steps once a guide pins them down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: not yet known)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; GTABase guesses it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, unconfirmed. Try driving a car through a showroom's front window and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The wording is unclear in the guides, so go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game; the exact trigger is still unconfirmed and this guide will update once it is pinned down.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. GTABase's method: max out Strength for both characters. Train Strength for Jason and for Lucia until each hits the cap.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). GTABase links it to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change your profile. Note that the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so check a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known and no guide has pinned down the trigger yet; it is a story-flavoured secret trophy, so it most likely pops during a story moment — keep playing and it should come. This guide will update the steps once they are confirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: not yet known)

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, unconfirmed. Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring, and this guide will update once the trigger is confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx lists the steps as not yet known; the name points to bowling over targets with a melee drive-by attack, so try a melee drive-by near the bowling alley and watch for the pop.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx: not yet known)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder Marked Bills through fences — GTABase says one fence pays the most — and the total grows during the 100% robberies, so it builds up on its own as you play.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It counts every dollar spent in shops, so it climbs naturally as you buy weapons, clothes and cars; check the tracker to see how close you are and top it up with a big purchase if needed.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida and register each one in the Scooter Bros app until the counter hits ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
